g.text: Memory; process-tree PSS includes all workers and apportions shared pages
ROI cache on ten datasets: fixed replay, 5 epochs, up to 100 batches/epoch
Attached-chart values are rounded labels and use historical full-run conditions. ROI time is training wall time on fixed replay; compare directionally.
Main RSS is comparable in scope; process-tree PSS has no historical counterpart.
